name: afya_voice_surveillance_agent
description: Outbreak detection using MongoDB aggregation pipelines, vector similarity search, rolling baseline comparison, and multi-syndrome correlation.

tools.name: run_outbreak_detection
tools.description: Run geospatial cluster pipeline for a county. Compares against 4-week rolling baselines. Returns alerts for any detected outbreaks.

tools.name: run_vector_search
tools.description: Atlas Vector Search for semantically similar cases within 50km. Requires vector_index on encounters.embedding.

tools.name: update_baselines
tools.description: Recalculate 4-week rolling baselines for each syndrome per county. Stores in baselines collection.

parameters.county: string (optional) — if omitted, updates all counties

tools.name: create_vector_index
tools.description: Idempotent: creates the Atlas Vector Search index on encounters.embedding.

tools.name: get_county_stats
tools.description: Quick stats for a county: encounters today, active alerts.
